objective: Close X1/X2 LiteRT-LM source and embeddable bridge spikes as recorded spike decisions, without adding a production provider or model download path.

criteria.promise: X1 documents and scripts require explicit MODEL_PATH, Apple Silicon/macOS, pinned Bazel, arm64 binary, real CPU inference output, and reject GPU as unavailable rather than treating build success as runtime health.

X2 bridge uses upstream public C++ APIs in an isolated spike target, requires a real sentinel response, exposes speculative-decoding capability only from upstream metadata, and introduces no BeLauncher production dependency.
The production Swift package/provider registry does not expose LiteRT-LM, E4B or the bridge as a usable provider until runtime/model/memory gates are separately satisfied.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect docs/spikes/litert-lm-x1.md and Scripts/spike-litert-lm-x1.sh; run shell syntax checks.
verification_gates.expected: Opt-in model path, Bazel pin and real CPU run are documented; GPU negative result is explicit.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect docs/spikes/litert-lm-x2.md, Scripts/spike-litert-lm-x2.sh and bridge source.
verification_gates.expected: Bridge is isolated under upstream Bazel and checks X2_OK/speculative metadata without editing Package.swift.

verification_gates.procedure: Search product sources/package for LiteRT production integration.
verification_gates.expected: Only spike docs/scripts/primitives mention LiteRT/MTP; no production provider is registered.

recon_evidence: LiteRT X1/X2 spike docs, scripts and production source search were inspected. This ticket accepts only the spike decision and explicitly forbids adding a production LiteRT provider.
